deeper-life-in-christ.title: Obulamu obw'Omunda Ennyo: Kristo mu Mmwe
deeper-life-in-christ.description: Si kufuba kusinga, wabula Omuntu: ekyama ky'obulamu obw'omunda ennyo ye Kristo yennyini abeera munda mu ffe. Andrew Murray atandika n'ekyewuunyo kya Yesu Yennyini, n'oluvannyuma abikkula obulamu bwa Kristo abeera munda, ne Hudson Taylor amaliriza mu kuwummula kw'okwegatta n'okussa ekimu n'Omwagalwa.
note: Job #1212. Vocabulary is taken from the shipped Luganda corpus rather than rendered fresh: «Kristo … abeera mu mmwe» is Colossians 1:27 as the OLCB reads it, «obulamu obw'omunda» is the settled term for the inner/deeper life (humility-2.lg, the-inner-chamber.lg), and «okwegatta» / «okussa ekimu» are the corpus's union / communion. «Yesu Yennyini» is deliberate — it is the shipped lg title of jesus-himself-2, the first book this plan opens, so the card and the book agree.

This row cannot appear yet: seed_plans creates a plan only in a language where EVERY source book is published in it, and two of the three (the-masters-indwelling, union-and-communion) are still English-only. The prose is correct and waiting; the card goes live with whichever of those books lands second.

faith-in-the-fire.title: Katonda ow'Okubudaabuda Kwonna: Okukkiriza mu Muliro
faith-in-the-fire.description: Ku nnaku ezo ezisinga okuzibuwalira okusaba. Hannah Whitall Smith ku Katonda ow'okubudaabuda kwonna, ne Gareth Evans ku kwesiga oyo akwata ennaku zaffe ez'omu maaso — olugendo lwa wiiki ttaano okutuuka mu mirembe eginywevu ng'obulamu tebukakafu.

humility-12-days.title: Obwetoowaze mu Nnaku 12
humility-12-days.description: Ekitabo kya Andrew Murray eky'edda ku musingi gwa buli mpisa ennungi — essuula emu ennyimpi buli lunaku okumala ennaku kkumi na bbiri.

power-from-on-high.title: Amaanyi Agava Waggulu: Omwoyo Omutukuvu
power-from-on-high.description: Wiiki nnya ne R. A. Torrey ku bulamu obujjudde Omwoyo: okusooka okubatizibwa n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu n'amaanyi ge galeeta olw'obuweereza, n'oluvannyuma okuyiga okujjuvu ku Muntu n'omulimu gw'Omwoyo abeera mu buli mukkiriza.

school-of-prayer.title: Emisingi gy'Okusaba
school-of-prayer.description: Wiiki nnya ez'okuzimba emisingi gy'okusaba n'abakulembeze basatu: Andrew Murray ku ngeri Mukama gy'atuyigiriza yekka okusaba, D. L. Moody ku kusaba okuwangula, ne Hannah Buyinza ku kusaba ng'okukuba kw'omutima okwa buli lunaku mu bulamu obw'Ekikristaayo.
note: 2026-10-01: retitled from «Essomero ery'Okusaba» to follow the English rename «A School of Prayer» → «Foundations in Prayer». AI-drafted; the description's opening «Wiiki nnya mu ssomero ery'okusaba» became «Wiiki nnya ez'okuzimba emisingi gy'okusaba» to match.

the-inner-chamber-month.title: Omwezi mu Kisenge eky'omunda
the-inner-chamber-month.description: Zimba empisa eya buli lunaku ey'okusaba n'Ekigambo: enkya amakumi asatu mu mukaaga ne Andrew Murray, essuula emu buli lunaku.

grace-for-every-sinner.title: Ekkubo Erituusa eri Katonda: Ekisa eri Buli Mwonoonyi
grace-for-every-sinner.description: Omwezi ku mawulire amalungi ag'edda okusinga gonna. Okukoowoola kwa Richard Baxter okuwoomerevu eri abo abatannakyuka, Moody ng'ayogera ku kkubo erituusa eri Katonda, ne «Byonna Bya Kisa» bya Charles Spurgeon — abalagirizi abasingayo obulambulukufu ku ngeri omwonoonyi gy'alokolebwamu, n'engeri gy'ayinza okukimanyiramu.
note: Job #1509 (PR pending). Curated 3-book plan: a-call-to-the-unconverted, the-way-to-god, all-of-grace.

Book titles quoted to match the shipped Luganda editions: «Byonna Bya Kisa» (all-of-grace.lg) for Spurgeon's 'All of Grace'; 'ekkubo erituusa eri Katonda' echoes the-way-to-god.lg title 'Ekkubo Erituusa eri Katonda'.
a-call-to-the-unconverted is not yet in Luganda, so seed_plans will NOT create the (grace-for-every-sinner, lg) row until that third book ships; the prose lands now, ready for then.

everything-for-christ.title: Byonna ku lwa Kristo: Obulamu Obwayiibwa
everything-for-christ.description: Okwewaayo n'omutima gwonna kuwera ki, era kuvaamu ki? Ebyawandiikibwa bya David Brainerd ebya buli lunaku mu buminsani, ebikebera omutima, oluvannyuma n'ebyafaayo by'abasajja n'abakazi abaawaayo byonna ku lw'enjiri — okuyitibwa eri okwewaayo okwogerwa nga kuyita mu bulamu obwakwanukula.
note: Job #1510 (PR pending). Curated 2-book plan: life-and-diary-of-david-brainerd, men-and-women-who-gave-everything-2.
Neither source book is in Luganda yet, so seed_plans will NOT create the (everything-for-christ, lg) row until both ship; the prose lands now, ready for then.
surrender/consecration rendered okwewaayo per the lg glossary.

growing-in-wisdom-18-days.title: Okukula mu Magezi mu Nnaku 18
growing-in-wisdom-18-days.description: Obulagirizi bwa James DeGreef eri abayizi — okusoma okumu okutono buli lunaku okumala ennaku kkumi na munaana. Okuva ku kuzuula ekigendererwa kyo okutuuka ku kwetegekera ebiseera byo eby'omu maaso, buli lunaku lugatta amagezi ag'omugaso n'Ekyawandiikibwa, okulowooza, n'okusaba.

brave-for-god-24-true-stories.title: Abavumu ku lwa Katonda: Emboozi 24 Ez'amazima
brave-for-god-24-true-stories.description: Wiiki ssatu n'ekitundu ez'emboozi ez'amazima eri abasomi abato, emu buli lunaku: ebitabo byonna ebina eby'Abavumu ku lwa Katonda — abantu abaabulijjo amakumi abiri mu bana okuva mu buli nsonda y'ensi abeesiga Katonda ne bafuulibwa abavumu.
note: AI-drafted; awaiting native review. All four Luganda volumes now use the series name in series.json ("Abavumu ku lwa Katonda"), and this plan follows it so the plan agrees with the book pages' series line. If a native reviewer changes the series name, change the books, series.json and this plan together.

pursuit-of-holiness.title: Okunoonya Obutukuvu
pursuit-of-holiness.description: Wiiki mwenda ez’okubeera aba Mukama mu bujjuvu. Andrew Murray alaga nti obutukuvu bwaffe busibuka mu kwegatta kwaffe n’Omutukuvu, William Law atuyita mu bulamu obwewaddeyo eri Katonda mu buli ssaawa ey’abulijjo, ne John Wesley annyonnyola mu lwatu okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo kye kuli — ne kye kutali.
note: Job #1337: ships with holy-in-christ.lg («Omutukuvu mu Kristo»), the plan's first source book, so the card never appears English-titled. «obutukuvu» / «Omutukuvu» follow that edition and the OLCB (1 Peter 1:15-16). Names follow the lg corpus: John Wesley (27×), William Law (4×).

The row cannot appear yet: a-serious-call and plain-account-christian-perfection have no lg edition, and seed_plans creates a plan only where every source book is published. AI-drafted; awaiting native review.

christ-our-healer.title: Kristo Omuwonya Waffe
christ-our-healer.description: Wiiki mukaaga ku Kristo nga Omulokozi, Omutukuza, Omuwonya, era Kabaka Ajja. A. B. Simpson annyonnyola enjiri ey’ebitundu ebina n’obuweereza bwayo obw’okuwonya, ne Andrew Murray afundikira n’omwezi gw’okufumiitiriza ku Mukama akyawonya omubiri ng’omusingo gw’obulamu obugenda okujja.
note: Job #3047, shipped with #1691 (the-gospel-of-healing.lg, «Enjiri y’Okuwonya»): that book completes the curated christ-our-healer set in lg, so seed_plans creates the (christ-our-healer, lg) row on this deploy. The other two source books were already Luganda: the-fourfold-gospel.lg («Enjiri ey’Ebitundu Ebina») and divine-healing.lg («Okuwonya kwa Katonda»).

«Kristo Omuwonya Waffe» is the-fourfold-gospel.lg's own chapter 3 title, and «Omulokozi, Omutukuza, Omuwonya, era Kabaka Ajja» is that edition's subtitle, so the card quotes the book it opens. AI-drafted; awaiting native review.

school-of-prayer-31-days.title: Ennaku 31 mu Ssomero ly’Okusaba
school-of-prayer-31-days.description: Omwezi gumu ne Andrew Murray ku bigere by’Omuyigiriza yekka. Buli lunaku lubikkula ekimu ku bigambo bya Yesu yennyini ku kusaba, okuva ku “Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba” okutuuka ku bisuubizo by’ekiro ekyasembayo, era lukomekkerezebwa n’okusaba kwalwo. Essomo limu buli lunaku, nga eddakiika kkumi, nga lizimba okutuuka ku kwegayiririra abalala n’obulamu obw’okusaba.
note: Job #3149 (book:school-of-prayer -> lg) adds the plan's only source book, so its prose ships in the same PR (PlanTranslationCoverageTests); this also covers job #5291. The title quotes the shipped book title «Wamu ne Kristo mu Ssomero ly’Okusaba» (as cited in ministry-of-intercession.lg) and the lessons' refrain ‘Mukama, tuyigirize okusaba’. AI-drafted, unreviewed.

voices-of-the-early-church.title: Amaloboozi g'Ekkanisa ey'Edda
voices-of-the-early-church.description: Ebyasa ebisooka eby'Obukristaayo mu bigambo byabwe bennyini. Clement ow'e Ruumi awandiika ng'ali mu kkanisa ey'e Ruumi ng'omulembe gw'abatume bennyini gukyaliwo, Ignatius ow'e Antiyokiya aweereza ebbaluwa ze ng'ali mu kkubo erimutwala okuttibwa olw'okukkiriza, ne Athanasius ow'e Alegezanderiya annyonnyola omutima gw'okukkiriza — lwaki Katonda yennyini yafuuka omuntu — mu kitabo kye ku Kufuuka Omuntu kw'Omwana wa Katonda. Ebisomwa ebimpi buli lunaku okumala emyezi nga ena.
note: Job #3049. AI-drafted ahead of the books; awaiting native review. None of first-epistle-of-clement, epistles-of-ignatius or on-the-incarnation is in Luganda yet, so seed_plans creates the (voices-of-the-early-church, lg) row only once all three are published here; their lg book jobs never need to write this shared file. Place names follow the OLCB (Ruumi, Antiyokiya, Alegezanderiya; Acts 28:16, 11:26, 18:24); Athanasius and Ignatius follow the lg corpus. «On the Incarnation» is described, not quoted as a title — align it with the lg edition's title when that ships.

send-the-fire.title: Weereza Omuliro: Okusabira Okuzuukusibwa
send-the-fire.description: Engeri okuzuukusibwa gye kujja, n'engeri y'okukusaba kukke. Charles Finney mu misomo gye ku ebyo okuzuukusibwa bye kwetaaga, R. A. Torrey ku kubatizibwa n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okukuwa amaanyi, n'obubaka Katonda bwe yakozesa okukankanya New England mu biseera bya Jonathan Edwards.
note: Job #3052. AI-drafted ahead of the books; awaiting native review. Only baptism-with-the-holy-spirit is in Luganda («Okubatizibwa n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu», whose wording the description follows); revival-lectures and selected-sermons-edwards are not, so seed_plans creates the (send-the-fire, lg) row only once both are published here. «okuzuukusibwa» for revival is the commoner of the two lg corpus terms (41× against 38× «okudda obuggya»); Finney, Jonathan Edwards and New England follow the lg corpus.

the-pilgrims-way.title: Ekkubo ly'Omutambuze
the-pilgrims-way.description: Ekkubo eriddayo ewaka, mu bitabo bisatu eby'edda. Charles Spurgeon asisinkana omunoonyi ku mulyango omufunda, olugero lwa John Bunyan olutaggwaawo — «Olugendo lw'Omutambuze» — lugoberera omutambuze olugendo lwonna okutuuka mu Kibuga eky'Omu Ggulu, n'obujulirwa bwa Bunyan bwennyini bulaga ekisa ekyayitirira eri asinga aboonoonyi bonna.
note: Queue job #3053. AI-drafted; awaiting native review. «Olugendo lw'Omutambuze» quotes the shipped lg title of pilgrims-progress, and the plan title echoes it. around-the-wicket-gate and grace-abounding have no lg edition yet, so seed_plans will not create the (the-pilgrims-way, lg) row until both ship; their translators should check this prose against those titles.

the-puritan-heart.title: Omutima gw'Abapuritani
the-puritan-heart.description: Wiiki munaana n'abayigiriza basatu ab'obulamu obw'omunda. Richard Sibbes asiba olumuli olubetense, John Owen alwanyisa ekibi ekikyabeera mu ffe, ne Thomas Watson ateeka olutalo lwonna ku kisuubizo nti ebintu byonna bikolera wamu olw'obulungi.
note: Queue job #3050. AI-drafted; awaiting native review. «olumuli olubetense» echoes Isaiah 42:3 / Matthew 12:20, and «ebintu byonna bikolera wamu olw'obulungi» Romans 8:28. None of the three source books (the-bruised-reed, mortification-of-sin, all-things-for-good) has an lg edition yet, so seed_plans will not create the (the-puritan-heart, lg) row until all three ship; their translators should check this prose against those titles.

praying-men.title: Abasajja Abasaba: Essomero ly'Okusaba ne E. M. Bounds
praying-men.description: Wiiki musanvu mu kyokero ky'okwegayirira wamu n'omutume omukulu ow'okusaba. E. M. Bounds atandika n'obwetaavu bw'omubuulizi bwennyini obw'amaanyi, oluvannyuma n'annyonnyola ekigendererwa ekifuula okusaba okuwangula, n'obwetaavu obukufuula omulimu gwonna ogw'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo.
note: Queue job #3048. AI-drafted; awaiting native review. «amaanyi» echoes the shipped lg title of power-through-prayer («Amaanyi Agava mu Kusaba»). purpose-in-prayer and necessity-of-prayer have no lg edition yet, so seed_plans will not create the (praying-men, lg) row until both ship; their translators should check this prose against those titles.

first-steps-for-teens.title: Okutandika: Okukkiriza eri Abavubuka
first-steps-for-teens.description: Olugendo olusooka ne Yesu, eri abasomi abavubuka. Charles Spurgeon akusisinkana ku mulyango n'obuyambi obusingayo obwangu eri buli anoonya ekkubo erigenda eri Kristo; oluvannyuma emboozi ez'amazima ez'abasajja n'abakazi abaamuwaayo byonna ziraga obulamu obwo kye bufuuka — ebitabo bibiri ebimpi mu wiiki nga ssatu.
note: Queue job #2852. AI-drafted; awaiting native review. Neither source book (around-the-wicket-gate, men-and-women-who-gave-everything-2) has an lg edition yet, so seed_plans will not create the (first-steps-for-teens, lg) row until both ship; their translators should check this prose against those titles.

days-of-heaven-upon-earth-year.title: Omwaka Gumu: Ennaku ez’Eggulu ku Nsi
days-of-heaven-upon-earth-year.description: Omwaka gwa A. B. Simpson ogw’okusinza okwa buli lunaku: olunyiriri lumu n’okufumiitiriza okumpi ku bujjuvu bwa Kristo ku buli lunaku. Tandika ku lunaku lwonna: olunaku olusooka kye kisomebwa kya nga 1 Janwali, era buli lunaku oluddako lutwala ekiddako. Eddakiika emu oba bbiri buli lunaku.

thoughts-for-the-quiet-hour-year.title: Omwaka Gumu: Ebirowoozo by’Essaawa ey’Akasirise
thoughts-for-the-quiet-hour-year.description: Ebisomebwa ebimpi D. L. Moody bye yakuŋŋaanya eby’omwaka gwonna: olunyiriri lumu n’ebigambo bitono okuva mu babuulizi n’abawandiisi be yali ayagala. Tandika ku lunaku lwonna: olunaku olusooka kye kisomebwa kya nga 1 Janwali, era buli lunaku oluddako lutwala ekiddako. Eddakiika emu buli lunaku.

cheque-book-year.title: Omwaka Gumu: Ekitabo kya Cheeki eky’Ebbanka y’Okukkiriza
cheque-book-year.description: Ebisuubizo bya Charles Spurgeon ebya buli lunaku: ekisuubizo kimu ekya Katonda ku buli lunaku lw’omwaka, n’ekigambo ekimpi ku ngeri y’okukifunamu olw’okukkiriza. Tandika ku lunaku lwonna: olunaku olusooka kye kisomebwa kya nga 1 Janwali, era buli lunaku oluddako lutwala ekiddako. Eddakiika emu oba bbiri buli lunaku.
